title: That Might of Faith, O Lord! Bestow
description: That Might of Faith, O Lord! Bestow in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in the supplement of the 1866 edition of A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1866), as hymn 526, “Prayer for Faith”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: That might of faith, O Lord! be-stow, Which can-not ask in vain; Which will not let the an-gel go Un-til the prayer it gain.

lines: That might of faith, O Lord! bestow,
Which will not let the angel go
On me the faith divine bestow
And all my spotless life shall show
And, Father, when I doubt that I
Can live, and sin no more;
Then if on Thee I dare rely,
The faith shall bring the power.

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1866.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1866); set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
